docker.title: Docker Inventory Collection
docker.subtitle: Docker monitoring is now built into the PatchMon Go agent
docker.discovery_desc: The PatchMon Go agent automatically discovers Docker when it's available on your host and collects comprehensive inventory information:
docker.feature_containers_desc: Running and stopped containers with status, images, ports, and labels
docker.feature_images_desc: All Docker images with repository, tags, sizes, and sources
docker.feature_volumes_desc: Named and anonymous volumes with drivers, mountpoints, and usage
docker.feature_networks_desc: Docker networks with drivers, IPAM configuration, and connected containers
docker.feature_realtime_desc: Container status changes are pushed instantly via WebSocket
docker.step1: Install the PatchMon Go agent on your host (see the Hosts page for installation instructions)
docker.step2: The agent automatically detects if Docker is installed and running on the host
docker.step3: During each collection cycle, the agent gathers Docker inventory data and sends it to the PatchMon server
docker.step4_prefix: View your complete Docker inventory (containers, images, volumes, networks) in the
docker.step5: Container status changes are pushed to the server in real-time via WebSocket connection
docker.no_config_desc: Once the Go agent is installed and Docker is running on your host, Docker inventory collection happens automatically. No separate Docker agent or cron jobs needed.
docker.req_agent: PatchMon Go agent must be installed and running
docker.req_docker: Docker daemon must be installed and running
docker.req_socket_prefix: Agent must have access to the Docker socket (
docker.req_root: Typically requires running the agent as root or with Docker group permissions

checkmk.title: Checkmk integration
checkmk.subtitle: Export hosts as CSV for import into Checkmk
checkmk.desc_prefix: Export your PatchMon host list in the
checkmk.desc_suffix: . Use the file in Checkmk under Setup > Hosts > Import hosts via CSV file.
checkmk.fields_desc_full: Full set of Checkmk import attributes (Host name, Alias, Monitored on site, IPv4, IPv6, SNMP community, Tag: Criticality, Tag: Networking Segment, Tag: Checkmk agent / API integrations, Tag: Piggyback, Tag: SNMP, Tag: IP address family). Empty columns can be filled in Checkmk or in the CSV before import.
checkmk.fields_desc_basic: Columns: hostname, IPv4 address, alias, and Checkmk agent tag (cmk-agent). Hostnames are limited to 240 characters per Checkmk.
checkmk.additional_fields_desc: When enabled, the CSV includes all attributes from the Checkmk import docs (section 6.1). PatchMon only fills hostname, alias, IPv4, and agent; other columns are empty for you to edit in Checkmk or before re-import.
checkmk.no_permission: You do not have permission to view hosts.
